learning_objective: 🎯 Let us follow the exciting adventure of a river as it flows from snowy mountains all the way down to the deep blue ocean!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Most rivers start high up in the mountains when snow and ice melt into sparkling drops of water. These drops join together to make tiny, fast-moving streams!
As the stream travels down the mountain, it gets wider and slower, becoming a mighty river. It flows through green valleys and plains, giving water to farms, animals, and cities along the way.
After a very long trip across the land, the river finally reaches its destination. It pours all its fresh water into the salty, giant ocean!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Make Your Own Mini River!
fun_activity.instructions: Crumple a piece of aluminum foil to look like mountains and valleys, place it on a tray, and slowly pour a little water at the top to watch your very own river flow down!

quick_recap: ⭐ Rivers are nature's highways of water that usually start from melting snow on high mountains.
⭐ They provide essential water for farming, drinking, and animals as they journey across the land.
⭐ Every river eventually ends its long trip by flowing into a sea or an ocean.
